title: Procedural Knowledge Extraction from Industrial Troubleshooting Guides Using Vision Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2601.22754v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Industrial troubleshooting guides encode diagnostic procedures in flowchart-like diagrams where spatial layout and technical language jointly convey meaning. To integrate this knowledge into operator support systems, which assist shop-floor personnel in diagnosing and resolving equipment issues, the information must first be extracted and structured for machine interpretation. However, when performed manually, this extraction is labor-intensive and error-prone. Vision Language Models offer potential to automate this process by jointly interpreting visual and textual meaning, yet their performance on such guides remains underexplored. This paper evaluates two VLMs on extracting structured knowledge, comparing two prompting strategies: standard instruction-guided versus an augmented approach that cues troubleshooting layout patterns. Results reveal model-specific trade-offs between layout sensitivity and semantic robustness, info

translated_title: 使用视觉语言模型从工业故障排除指南中提取程序性知识
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.22754v2 公告类型：替换交叉发布  摘要：工业故障排除指南以流程图式图表编码诊断程序，其中空间布局和技术语言共同传达意义。为了将此知识集成到操作员支持系统中（该系统帮助车间人员诊断和解决设备问题），信息必须首先被提取并结构化以供机器解读。然而，当手动执行时，这种提取劳动密集且容易出错。视觉语言模型通过联合解释视觉和文本意义，为自动化此过程提供了潜力，但其在此类指南上的性能仍未得到充分探索。本文评估了两种视觉语言模型在提取结构化知识方面的表现，比较了两种提示策略：标准指令引导与一种增强方法，该方法提示故障排除布局模式。结果揭示了模型在布局敏感性和语义鲁棒性之间的特定权衡。
tldr: 本文评估了两种视觉语言模型在从工业故障排除指南中提取结构化程序性知识时的表现，并比较了不同提示策略，揭示了模型在布局理解与语义稳健性之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper evaluates two vision language models for extracting structured procedural knowledge from industrial troubleshooting guides, comparing prompting strategies and revealing trade-offs between layout sensitivity and semantic robustness.
